nieuw.titel: Buy champions to preserve units through defensive challenges
nieuw.tekst: Include champions so their defensive challenges can preserve the rest of a unit. He recommends designing anvils around this: surviving models get a chance to fall back in good order, buying another combat and potentially denying the opponent the unit's full points.
nieuw.waarom: He explains that the champion absorbs attacks that would otherwise remove more models. In his view, falling back in good order and the difficulty of destroying every model make challenges useful for preserving both tempo and points.
nieuw.voorbeeld: His Sisters of Avelorn champion challenged a charging mounted sorcerer, leaving seven models alive with a chance to fall back in good order.
